title: Chargeable Nights per Week for Top-Tier Ashbury Rewards Members under the Guest Folios Weekly Parking Maximum
content:
The two top tiers of Ashbury Rewards carry their own chargeable nights per week under the weekly parking maximum on Guest Folios.

**Rate.** Chargeable nights per week: the Ambassador chargeable nights of 5 for an Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite member, and the Titanium chargeable nights of 5.5 for an Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite member. Every other guest receives no tier figure under this rate card.

The tier is the tier shown on the Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay.

| Ashbury Rewards tier | Chargeable nights per week |
|---|---|
| Ambassador Elite | 5 |
| Titanium Elite | 5.5 |
| Any other tier, or no membership | No tier figure under this rate card |

## Reading the rate card (hypothetical basis rate of $40.00)

- **Ambassador Elite.** 5 chargeable nights: a weekly rate of $40.00 times 5, $200.00.
- **Titanium Elite.** 5.5 chargeable nights: a weekly rate of $40.00 times 5.5, $220.00.

The figure is a number of nights and may be fractional, as the Titanium figure of 5.5 is.
